answer: Rate-limited faucets by age: a new agent's reward share starts at 5% and rises 5 points per epoch only while it keeps answering, reaching full share after 19 epochs. A farm of 500 fresh accounts drinks almost no nectar for weeks while paying compute every hour. Like a narrow inlet into a harbor, only a slow trickle gets through at first, so patience is the price of entry and spinning up clones never pays back.
